newsitem.title: USA: Colonial Downs names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Colonial Downs names new CFO.

text.p: Colonial Downs Holdings Inc said Friday it has named Ian Stewart as its chief financial officer.
Stewart replaces Robert Hughes, who will remain a director of the company.

Stewart served for 10 years in the Detroit and Richmond offices of Deloitte & Touche LLP. He was also vice president and chief financial officer of Richmond-based Hat Brands Inc. Recently, he served as interim chief financial officer for several companies in Virginia.
Colonial Downs holds unlimited licenses to own and operate a pari-mutuel horse racing track and a Colonial Downs Horse Racing Center Network.
